component: Original Uploaded File Persistence & Disaster Recovery

local_filesystem.containment_check: resolve_tenant_path validates path does not escape tenant_root (PermissionError on traversal)
local_filesystem.atomic_writes: Writes to .tmp file then replaces target atomically

disaster_recovery_analysis.critical_distinction: PostgreSQL backups capture documents, document_versions, document_chunks, and chunk_embeddings. However, PostgreSQL pg_dump does NOT contain the raw uploaded PDF/DOCX/image binaries.
disaster_recovery_analysis.recovery_risk: Restoring only PostgreSQL without restoring the storage volume leaves document records referencing missing disk files, breaking raw document downloads and binary re-parsing.

mandatory_staging_procedure.option_a_local: Snapshot the persistent volume mounted at STORAGE_PATH concurrently with pg_dump; restore storage directory before starting application services.
mandatory_staging_procedure.option_b_s3: Enable S3 bucket versioning and multi-region replication; point staging to the restored bucket.
